shots.note: medium push_in: Diti sits in prayer in front of her hut with closed eyes, her hands folded and a faint gold glow around her; the title card sits above her.
medium dolly_left: Indra creeps forward in a crouch with a tense face, one hand holding the Vajra low, a thatched hut at the right behind him.
insert push_in: The womb glows in the dark red space with the unborn child curled inside, a bright white flash of the Vajra slicing across it.
insert pull_out: The womb now holds seven small glowing children, all alive and crying, spread around the sac.
medium tilt_up: Indra stands under storm clouds with a puzzled worried look, his crown glowing and the Vajra lowered, glancing sideways.
medium static: Diti stands calm in a maroon sari in her ashram yard, hands folded, and her name appears on 'Diti'.
two_shot dolly_right: Diti stands grieving at the left with a sad face while her two dead sons, the asuras Hiranyaksha and Hiranyakashipu, stand pale and faint like memories at the right.
two_shot push_in: Diti bows with pleading hands before the white-bearded sage Kashyapa who listens with a grave calm face and his kamandalu.
medium tilt_up: Kashyapa raises one finger in a stern warning with a grave face, his white beard and kamandalu clear in the yard.
medium push_in: Diti sits in calm prayer with closed eyes under a hundred small lights and the words '100 years' above her.
medium tilt_down: Diti stands at a water pot and pours water over her feet with a careful face; clear water splashes at her feet on 'washing'.
two_shot dolly_left: Kashyapa lifts a hand in warning at the left while Indra stands at the right with a friendly smile and the Vajra lowered, showing the friend the son would become.
medium dolly_right: Indra peeks out from behind the thatched hut at the right with a sly watchful face, one hand on the wall, under a dusk sky.
medium static: Diti sits perfectly still in prayer with serene closed eyes and a steady golden glow, no flaw anywhere.
medium pull_out: Diti sits in prayer inside a ring of golden light and a glowing yantra that shields her like fort walls.
medium tilt_down: Diti, now pregnant with a round belly in her maroon sari, stands in the yard with a hand resting near it and a peaceful face.
close crane_down: A close bust of Indra with a fearful tense face and eyes darting sideways, the storm sky dark behind his crown.
medium push_in: Diti sits wearily with drooping eyes and a heavy belly, one hand pressed to her side, in the evening yard.
wide pull_out: Diti lies asleep on a mat with her eyes closed and her dusty unwashed feet toward the viewer under a night sky.
medium handheld: Indra leaps forward with the Vajra in his raised hand and an eager grin, a streak of dust behind him.
insert push_in: The womb glows red-gold with the curled unborn child and tiny Indra with the Vajra inside it.
extreme_close handheld: A blinding blue-white flash of the Vajra cuts across the womb, the glowing child beneath it.
insert push_in: Seven small glowing children float apart in the womb, each one separate.
medium pull_out: Indra freezes with wide eyes and the Vajra lowered, mouth open in shock.
insert push_in: Seven small children glow in the womb with open crying mouths, pulsing as they cry.
medium dolly_right: Indra shouts with his mouth wide open and hands pushed forward, and the word 'Maruda' appears big beside him.
medium push_in: Indra pleads with both hands out and a desperate pleading face, begging the tiny children to stop.
insert handheld: Seven glowing children scream with wide open mouths in the womb and the sac shakes with their sound.
close push_in: The womb fills with forty-nine small glowing children after a white slash of the Vajra.
insert pull_out: Forty-nine small children cry with open mouths in the womb, spread wide and glowing.
medium tilt_up: Diti sits up from her mat in surprise with wide eyes and a hand on her belly.
wide pan_right: Indra runs away across the dark yard with his Vajra and a scared face, glancing back over his shoulder.
wide crane_up: Forty-nine tiny storm-god babies with blue halos sit in a grid of seven rows, crying, as dawn light rises behind them; Diti sits smiling above.
medium push_in: Indra stands calm and unharmed under a clear sky with a few small storm-god babies in front of him not attacking.
medium dolly_left: Indra smiles with a baby storm god on each side and Kashyapa nodding behind them; light halos glow warm around all.
medium tilt_up: Indra shouts with his mouth open and a hand raised, the word 'Maruda' glowing next to him as in the womb.
medium push_in: Three grown storm gods with fan crowns and storm halos stand side by side in wind and clouds, calm and strong; the name 'Marutas' appears above them.
medium pull_out: Indra stands relieved with a calm smile, one hand open and his crown glowing in clear light.
wide crane_up: Indra stands in the middle with a row of Marutas on each side, storm-god brothers in blue with halos, all standing beside him; the number 49 appears.
